question: How should the guru contemplate the goddess during installation according to the aim of the rite?
premises: The contemplation varies according to the aim and practice of the rite.
At the time of installation, the guru should remember the goddess.
The supreme goddess abides in the middle of the triad as non-differentiating.
inference: Depending on the rite's aim, the guru should contemplate the supreme non-differentiating goddess at the center of the triad.
plain_english: At the time of installation, the guru should contemplate according to the aim and practice of the rite. The supreme goddess, abiding in the middle of the triad, is the non-differentiating one.
